test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

You should / avail this opportunity / to demonstrate / your skills.
solution:
**The erroneous part is "avail this opportunity"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, we need to use "yourself of" after "avail"
 
• In the given sentence, "avail" is a di-transitive verb that can have two objects (Direct object and Indirect object). Whenever we don't know what object we have to use then we use a reflexive pronoun according to the main subject.
 
• Hence, we need to use "yourself of"
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• **Residents visiting the library could avail themselves** of the park district’s facilities and programs.
 
 

**So the correct sentence is-** *You should avail **yourself of this opportunity** to demonstrate your skills.*
